edges.label: Abolished 1974; functions passed through ERDA to the Department of Energy
edges.note: The Energy Reorganization Act of 1974 abolished the Commission and vested its functions in the ERDA Administrator, and the NARA record group description names the Department of Energy as the eventual holder of the research, development and production functions.

title: Records of the Atomic Energy Commission, Record Group 326, Guide to Federal Records in the National Archives
